perplexity.description:
Chrysalis," released on October 8, 2021, by the contemporary classical duo AVAWAVES (Anna Phoebe and Aisling Brouwer) on One Little Independent Records, is their second full-length album following their 2019 debut "Waves". The album is rooted in cinematic and emotive narratives, blending classical string arrangements with ethereal keyboards and pulsating synths to create expansive, euphoric soundscapes. Its musical style is characterized by layered textures that build toward climactic moments, evoking a sense of dreamlike journey and emotional depth. The duo cites influences from surrealist visual artists and early cinematic works, which inform the album’s bold and expressive sonic palette.

"Chrysalis" has been well received critically, praised for its distinctive shimmering sound and sublime, celestial textures. Notable endorsements include Mary Anne Hobbs of BBC 6Music, who described the album as "beautiful," and Elizabeth Alker of BBC Radio 3, who highlighted its gorgeous, distinctive sound. The album’s 38-minute runtime features tracks that emphasize both instrumental virtuosity and cinematic atmosphere, positioning AVAWAVES as a significant voice in contemporary classical music with a modern, genre-blurring approach.
